objectives.success_criteria: Name the essential ideas and how they relate

first_activity.title: Get oriented and see what you already know
first_activity.context: Start with a small signal about your current understanding and the outcome you want. AME will use it to choose a useful next step.

questions.prompt: How familiar are you with this topic?
What would you like to be able to do first?
